{"evidence": "The gold patch adds explicit checks for IMPLICIT NONE and FORMAT statements in the fparser2 frontend, raising NotImplementedError when they are found. The agent patch adds tracking of implicit statements and raises GenerationError when an implicit statement other than 'implicit none' is found, but it does not check for FORMAT statements or ENTRY statements, which the gold patch does. The issue says 'fparser2 frontend currently ignores implicit statements' and 'abort if not', so the agent missed the FORMAT and ENTRY checks.", "failure_class": "model_failure", "confidence": 0.9}

=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
[psyir] fparser2 frontend currently ignores implicit statements
To date we have always (implicitly) assumed that the Fortran we are dealing with is using `implicit none`. The fparser2 psyir frontend needs extending to check that this is the case and to abort if not.
